questions.description: 字典实现默认值计数器。
字典求键值对数量变化。

questions.code_template:
sales = {"mon": 120, "tue": 90, "wed": 150}
total = sum(sales.values())
avg = total / len(sales)
best = max(sales, key=sales.get)
print(___)
questions.solution:
sales = {"mon": 120, "tue": 90, "wed": 150}
total = sum(sales.values())
avg = total / len(sales)
best = max(sales, key=sales.get)
print(f"Total: {total}, Avg: {avg}, Best: {best}")
